profile.summary:
I am a Backend and Full Stack Web Developer who is passionate about designing and coding innovative solutions to solve complex business problems. 

Technical Skills:
Python
HTML/CSS/Javascript
React
Kubernetes Microservices
Java (Sprint Boot)
Ruby on Rails
Scala
Go

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led, designed and developed full stack loan application software
using React, Spring Boot and Kubernetes Microservices – 100k+ active
users
• Championed, drove and implemented many features from technical
design to release
• Integrated Ocrolus and Plaid payment validation and verification
• Developed API endpoints and security framework to expose data
• Defined product requirements, architected, designed, developed a
real time data aggregation framework and visualization UI for 1000’s
of partner agents
• Conducted an internal security audit for fraud detection and
deterrence; identified, architected and implemented solutions
• Architected and developed internal Kubernetes tooling to improve
productivity and efficiency
• Led and mentored new hires for system onboarding
• Created system onboarding curriculum for new hires and held
regular knowledge transfer sessions
• Led and organized cross functional monthly learning sessions and
companywide social events

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack software engineer, primarily focused on making 100s of APIs available to 1000s business users by streamlining the deployment and development process with reusable security frameworks.

positions.title: TA for Application Design & Development
positions.description: Run labs and grade for 67-272 class on Ruby on Rails, database design, UI/UX, testcases and meeting business requirements.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software developer and test platform developer. 

•	Developed Python program to verify dynamic HTML page content through PA firewall with SSL decryption.
•	Developed testbench to stress test PA firewall’s ability to read and update URL category cache. The PA firewall cache is populated from a Django Cloud-based URL categorization list.
•	Developed application on Django framework to overload the PAN-OS firewall for testing purposes Developed Python program to analyze maximum concurrent traffic through PA firewall with SSL decryption.
•	Used Django to create development cloud server dedicated to URL filtering.

company.name: The Robotics Institute, Carnegie Mellon University

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Designed, fabricated and built research snake robots. Research included machining, PCB design and low level programming. Worked under Professor Howie Choset.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed and coded the front-end using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. 

Back-end coding included Postgres, Heroku, and Ruby on Rails development for database access. Analyzed page load time algorithm, implemented code to improved page load time by 1000% and debugged deployment issues.

http://www.sixdegreesoffrancisbacon.com/

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed features using HTML, PHP, CSS, MySQL and JavaScript for website: weightmi.com; worked under Professor Jeria Quesenberry.

educations.schoolName: Leland High School, San Jose, CA

honors.title: Dean's List Spring 2016

honors.title: Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship
honors.description: Researched robotic snakes with many joints that move independently in 3D space, exploring more than robotic snakes that mainly reside on 2D planes. This allows these robotics snakes to inspect and explore spaces that are unattainable from the floor.
honors.issuer: Issued by Carnegie Mellon University · May 2015

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentor high school students who build a 120 lb robot in 6 weeks to complete a game challenge. Areas of mentorship include creative writing, public relations, team building, robot design, robot manufacturing and software.

projects.title: BlockTrader: Mobile Food Ordering and Delivery Application
projects.description: Developed Swift mobile application similar to UberEats. Enables users to either 1) purchase food and have it delivered, or 2) deliver food to make a profit. Uses Facebook to obtain user information and perform user authentication. Also uses Stripe to process payments from buyers to sellers. Developed a custom-built Ruby on Rails API to manage a back-end database, which was hosted on our server. The project was co-sponsored and supported by Capital One.

projects.title: LED electronic sign application (personal project)
projects.description: Developed Python script to enter and manipulate message text for an electronic sign, because the original product software is no longer available.
